questions.prompt: A learner has recorded completion for the assessed course revision. Their separate request to share a workflow with everyone is still pending. Which description preserves both facts?

choices.text: The library request is approved because the learner completed certification.
choices.feedback: Course completion cannot supply a missing library review decision.

choices.text: Keep the earned course completion and describe the library request as pending.
choices.feedback: The two records describe separate processes. Do not invent approval or erase earned history.

choices.text: Remove earned completion until a staff examiner handles the library request.
choices.feedback: A separate pending request does not rewrite the demonstrated course outcomes.

questions.prompt: After a passing assessment, a workflow owner changes the prompt that selects the budget amount. The old evidence is intact, but no new run has been tested. What is justified?

choices.text: Apply the old passing result to the changed prompt because the workflow name is unchanged.
choices.feedback: The name does not establish that changed behavior was assessed.

choices.text: Delete the old evidence so only the latest prompt remains visible.
choices.feedback: The original evidence should remain traceable; deleting it hides what was actually assessed.

choices.text: Preserve the original achievement and test the changed revision before making a new quality claim.
choices.feedback: Earlier achievement remains historical evidence while changed behavior needs its own support.

questions.prompt: A learner is partway through a supported course when a new V5 course is offered. The new version adds source-review and release-decision requirements. Which transition respects the stated optional-upgrade policy?

choices.text: Switch the learner immediately and reset progress because V5 is newer.
choices.feedback: The optional policy requires an explicit choice and preserves existing earned work.

choices.text: Keep the current enrollment; preview new requirements and justified retained credit before an explicit upgrade choice.
choices.feedback: New requirements do not silently replace an active course, and retained credit needs an evidence-based mapping.

choices.text: Rename the old credential V5 and assume matching module titles prove the new skills.
choices.feedback: A title or XP total does not demonstrate newly required outcomes.

questions.prompt: The agent writes, “The learner checked every source and approved the internal handoff.” No learner decision or source-check record exists. A colleague says the workflow was popular before the edit. What can be concluded?

choices.text: Popularity plus the agent's statement establishes the missing review.
choices.feedback: Adoption and agent prose cannot establish the learner's own unrecorded judgments.

choices.text: The required learner review remains unproven; obtain the actual decisions and source evidence for this revision.
choices.feedback: The claim needs authenticated learner evidence tied to the assessed revision.

choices.text: Share the workflow with everyone to make the review claim valid.
choices.feedback: Changing access does not create source-check or learner-decision evidence.
